svg.title: Six layers of checks
svg.desc: Six layers in order: The build: 961 quotes of Marcus, each one exact span of its passage; 1,444 passage revisions hashed; Acceptance gates: 0 blocking findings over all 38 articles; 74 warnings for a person to read; Independent review: 18 of 19 first reviews sent the article back to its writer; Reading across: 79 findings: 68 overlaps, 7 contradictions, 4 labels; Tests: npm test every quote resolves, counts agree, both languages complete; Browser check: 360 · 390 · 1440 px wide, EN and RU, with and without Seneca; no text under 12 px.
svg.text: An article reaches the page only through all of them: two scripts, two readers who did
not write it, then tests and a browser.
